fouls.name: Cant Loss / Breath Fault
fouls.description: Raider loses the continuous audible cant ('Kabaddi') during the raid.
fouls.penalty: Raider is declared out, 1 point to opponent.

fouls.name: Empty Raid Violation (Do-or-Die)
fouls.description: If a team conducts two consecutive empty raids (no points scored), the 3rd raid becomes a 'Do-or-Die' raid. If no point is scored, the raider is out.
fouls.penalty: Raider is declared out, 1 point to defending team.

fouls.name: Stepping Out of Bounds
fouls.description: A player steps outside the court line or into the lobby before a touch is made.

fouls.name: Violent / Dangerous Tackle
fouls.description: Grabbing the raider by hair, throat, clothes, or intentionally tripping/injuring.
fouls.penalty: Foul, technical point awarded, warning or card.

fouls.name: Crossing Midline Early (Pursuit Fault)
fouls.description: More than one raider enters the opponent's court simultaneously or defenders cross midline before raid completion.
fouls.penalty: Technical point awarded to opposing team.
